verdict.rationale: Docs show you can open custom ports with -p arguments in the docker create/run options. Open ports are automatically exposed through per-port Cloudflare tunnels, and offers can be filtered by direct_port_count. For private networking, Vast documents overlay networks that give instances a private virtual LAN, but only for instances on machines that share the same physical LAN. Missing for 10: private networking across arbitrary hosts or datacenters, in-depth docs on port mapping and overlay setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
